caption:
₹2 lakh personal loan: why does only ₹1,95,280 reach your account?

Most lenders deduct the processing fee before the loan is disbursed. Fees run from about 0% to 3.5% of the loan.
At an illustrative 2%, that's ₹4,000, plus 18% GST on the fee (₹720). You receive ₹1,95,280.
Your EMI and interest are still worked out on the full ₹2 lakh.

Did you check the processing fee on your last loan?

Sources: two lenders' education pages on personal-loan processing fees and GST (one dated Oct 2026); the ₹ figures are our own illustrative arithmetic.

For education only. Not investment advice.
